question: Which of the following organs is related with the anatomy of the human eye?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iris.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Organs related to anatomy of eye:

 
 

 
 
Part

 
 
 
Work

 
 
 
 
 

 Pupil 
 Small empty space surrounded by the iris
 
 

 
 
Cornea

 
 
 
Acts as the eye’s outermost lens

 
 
 

 
 
**Iris**

 
 
 
**Controls the size of the pupil in the human eye**

 
 
 

 
 
Aqueous Humor

 
 
 
Nourishes the cornea and gives the eye its shape

 
 
 

 
 
Retina

 
 
 
Receive light and send signals to the brain for visual recognition.

 
 
 

**Hence Iris is related with the anatomy of the human eye.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• The **patella **is the largest sesamoid bone in the human body and is located anterior to **knee joint.**
 
• The **spleen **is a fist-sized organ in the upper left side of your abdomen, next to your stomach and behind your left ribs.
